features:
﻿- [BAN VA UI v5.0.2] Them hop thoai xac nhan truoc khi tat LUCAS 5S, tranh bam nham lam dong Scrcpy dang chay.
- [EDGE MENU 5 SLOT] Tu dong quet danh sach app qua ADB ngay khi bam Sua, cho phep chon & thay ca 5 nut menu ben phai (Slot #1..#5 / chuot phai) va luu ben vung.
- [KHO PLUG-IN & ICON] Lam gon giao dien Kho Plug-in va khoa cung bo icon chinh thuc LUCAS 5S trong goi OTA.
- [PHONE FARM & PI] Giu nguyen toan bo ban va duma.prop, Play Integrity 2/3, Zone.Identifier va UnsafeLoadFrom DLL tu v5.0.1.
